params.caption: 🖥️ Analysts link Nvidia GPU smuggling to Jensen Huang's exit Analyst firm SemiAnalysis says it has tracked more than 1.5 gigawatts' worth of banned Nvidia AI accelerators reaching China despite US export controls. Analysts suggest this mass smuggling could be the real reason behind Jensen Huang's departure as CEO. A separate report details an alleged $7.5 billion smuggling operation. These are analyst claims, not confirmed by Nvidia. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 14:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Tom's Hardware · Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia 🤔 Real reason or just a theory? React 👍 or 👎 and comment your take #Nvidia #JensenHuang #AIGPU #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
